issue_request: FHIR-13974 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Patient Care Procedure. It asked to clarify when Procedure.reasonCode versus Procedure.reasonReference should be used, add a usage comment that a Procedure can itself justify another Procedure, and allow Procedure.reasonReference to reference Procedure as well as Condition and Observation.
initial_application: The 2017-11-13 commit 52ac1cc0e7 applied the target-profile part of the issue in the same Procedure.reasonReference change family as FHIR-13975 and FHIR-14063. The 2018-07-20 commit 2abadfb0e6 explicitly mentioned GF#13974 and GF#16346 and added reasonCode/reasonReference usage comments.
additional_context: FHIR-16346 later clarified the same Procedure reason usage guidance and is already audited on the combined branch. Current source has refactored Procedure.reasonCode and Procedure.reasonReference into Procedure.reason CodeableReference with concept/reference guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Procedure source already includes Procedure as a reference target for Procedure.reason and explains when to use Procedure.reason.concept versus Procedure.reason.reference.
